menu.title: Status menu
menu.manage: Manage working hours and out of office
menu.locked: The status bar is included in a higher plan. The Available / Away switch in your account menu still works.

hours.title: Your working hours
hours.lead: Choose when you are available. Outside these hours your status switches to Away by itself.
hours.leadOther: Choose when this person is available. Outside these hours their status switches to Away by itself.
hours.locked: Automatic status from working hours is included in a higher plan.
hours.viewOnly: You can see these hours but not change them.
hours.automateHint: Away outside these hours, Available inside them. A status you set by hand lasts until the next change of hours.
hours.emptyWarning: No day is open, so you will always show as Available. Open at least one day.
hours.timezoneHint: Starts from your workspace time zone ({zone}).
